abstract.text: This article describes the KeyboardKit localization engine.

inlineContent.text: A flexible localization engine is an important part of a keyboard, where each supported locale should be able to localize a keyboard and its texts, layouts, callouts, accessibility, etc.
locales define localized strings, resources, input sets, keyboard layouts, and additional information. The native
type is also extended with additional capabilities.
